gloss: to flatter; to coax; to butter up

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: おだてていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To praise someone excessively, often insincerely, to put them in a good mood or get them to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おだてて⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To flatter subordinates into doing work.

examples.japanese: おだてられる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧しまう。
examples.english: When flattered, I tend to get carried away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おだてて⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦させよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{見抜|みぬ}かれた→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧。
examples.english: I tried to coax the child into studying by flattering them, but they saw through it.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). The person being flattered takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

PROVERB:
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おだてりゃ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ - Even a pig will climb a tree if you flatter it enough (flattery can motivate anyone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おだてる - to flatter (with insincere praise to get something)
- ⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧ - to praise (can be genuine)
- ⟦お{世辞|せじ}→お世辞：07023_oseji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to pay compliments (formal flattery)
- ⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧ - to praise/elevate someone

USAGE:
Often implies the flattery is insincere or has an ulterior motive.
